protocol: ACCEPTANCE audit over the 941-claim v2 (post generic-blocklist, post object_global). 50 claims, seed 41 — a FRESH draw, since the corpus changed. Graded untruncated against body+abstract+title via the repaired locator, under the DECLARED family-level granularity policy (D100), which is stated at the top of the grading file so it is applied rather than re-litigated. Labels frozen before any number was computed.

defect_notes.0: Pillar-0 is a 3D chest VLM the probe RUNS ON — P_BUILDS_ON, not evaluated-on. The vendor-list regex has no entry for a domain model like this
defect_notes.1: 'variational autoencoders' is (a) related work, not what the paper builds on, and (b) generic — the blocklist has 'vae' and 'autoencoder' but not the spelled-out plural
defect_notes.2: 'Nanbeige4.2' as a parent is fabricated from the model's own name; the paper says pretrained FROM SCRATCH
defect_notes.7: 'vector-quantized reconstruction' describes MSBraM's own mechanism, not a shared named artifact
defect_notes.8: 'collaborative filtering' is a technique class; missing from the blocklist
defect_notes.26: a SURVEY typed as evaluating on DeepLesion — the dataset belongs to a work the survey reviews, not to the survey
defect_notes.28: EEG Conformer is a frozen trunk Nimbus personalises — P_BUILDS_ON; another model the vendor list cannot know
defect_notes.30: PI-DON is a physics-informed DeepONet architecture, not a dataset

conventions_carried_across_at_D102: a benchmark paper types models it scores as P_COMPARES_TO
a descriptive noun-phrase subject is permitted when the paper names no method

survivors.nature: evidential standard — Sol requires the comparison be visible in the provided window; I inferred it from a truncated baselines section. Sol is probably right, so 0.84 is likely 2-4 points generous.

verdict: AT THE GATE — band 0.78-0.84, both CIs contain 0.80, kappa 0.806 (substantial). Not declared accepted on one rater. Owed: wider audit evidence windows so compared-against claims are confirmed not inferred.
